rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Tenant data was leaking - new tenants could see ALL data from other tenants
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In permissions.py, get_user_tenant() returned empty string for users without tenant_id. The tq() function only added tenant_id filter when tenant_id was non-empty. This meant users without tenant_id got NO filter applied, seeing ALL data.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: get_user_tenant() now returns '__no_tenant__' for users without tenant_id. This impossible value ensures tq() adds a filter that matches nothing, preventing data leaks.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: 17 backend tests confirm: new users see 0 data, tenant admins see only their data, super admin sees all data.
